message_log.content: Swarm swarm-20260206-1909 initialized. Mission: Compare top 10 LOMAH system solutions worldwide — catalog features, specifications, architecture, and pricing to identify best-in-class benchmarks for BB-01 development. 2 workers + 1 lead + 1 shadow.

Mission decomposed into 4 tasks. Tasks 001 and 002 are parallel-safe (no dependencies). Task 003 depends on task-001 (needs the system list). Task 004 depends on all three. worker-01 (researcher): task-001 then task-003. worker-02 (analyst): task-002 then task-004. Context from swarm-20260206-1220 (BB-01 mic selection) available — BB-01 system constraints in outputs/bb01-lomah-constraints.md. Estimated total: ~60 min per worker (within 90-min deadline).

ASSIGNMENT: Start with task-001 (identify top 10 LOMAH systems, 30 min). Cast a wide net — NATO, Russian, Chinese, Indian, Israeli manufacturers. Include both established players (Steinert, Oakwood, Polytronic) and newer entrants. When complete, HANDOFF to shadow-01, then pick up task-003 (architecture deep-dive, 30 min). Output format: structured tables with sourced data. Save artifacts to outputs/.

ASSIGNMENT: Start with task-002 (comparison framework, 20 min). Reference BB-01 design targets from swarm-20260206-1220 outputs (bb01-lomah-constraints.md, mic-selection-recommendation.md). When complete, HANDOFF to shadow-01, then wait for task-001 and task-003 before starting task-004 (comparative analysis + BB-01 gap analysis, 30 min). Save artifacts to outputs/.

key_decisions.decision: Same parallelization pattern as swarm-20260206-1220: tasks 001+002 parallel, task-003 sequential after 001, task-004 gated on all three.
key_decisions.rationale: Proven pattern from previous swarm. Researcher catalogs systems while analyst builds framework independently. Task-003 needs the system list from task-001 before deep-diving architectures.

key_decisions.decision: Include non-Western LOMAH manufacturers (Russia, China, India, Israel) alongside NATO suppliers for comprehensive competitive landscape.
key_decisions.rationale: BB-01 is a Vietnamese defense program. Vietnam procures from diverse suppliers. Understanding the full competitive landscape — not just Western systems — provides better benchmarking.

lessons_learned.lesson: Parallel-first task decomposition works well for research + framework pairs. Saved ~31 minutes by running task-001 and task-002 concurrently.

System list flexibility between framework and catalog is acceptable when documented. task-002 proposed 10 candidate systems; task-001 found better-documented alternatives. Adaptation produced higher quality output.
Competitive intelligence inherently has data gaps. [TBC] and [est.] markers with per-system confidence ratings are a best practice for honest reporting.
Cross-referencing between artifacts during the capstone analysis task catches inconsistencies early. Dependency gating (task-004 after tasks 001+002+003) enforces this workflow.
